select
from CHB_TRANS_MONTH where SEND_STATUS != '01' and TERMID = #{termid,jdbcType=CHAR}

select
from CHB_TRANS_MONTH where SEND_STATUS = '01' and TERMID = #{termid,jdbcType=CHAR}

select
from CHB_TRANS_MONTH_TEMPLATE where STATUS = 'E' and REPORTTYPE = #{reporttype,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by ORDERNO

select position.PROD_ID prodId, position.ASSETVALUE_A assetvalueA, position.ASSETVALUE_B assetvalueB, position.TERMS terms, position.SUNASSETTYPE sunassettype, position.SUNASSETTYPE2 sunassettype2, info.IS_TRANSFER isFprod, asset.ISSUE_MODE issueMode, asset.BANK_CAPITAL bankCapital, asset.SHARES_TYPE sharesType, info.IS_FHXGCP isFhxgcp, position.ASSETTYPE2 assetType2 from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION position left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO info on info.PROD_ID = position.PROD_ID and info.STATUS in ('M', 'E') and info.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' left join CHB_ASSET_INFO asset on asset.ASSET_CODE = position.ASSET_CODE where position.ENDDATE >= #{firstday, jdbcType=DATE} and position.ENDDATE <= #{lastday, jdbcType=DATE}
